title: feat(app-shell,components): Open the full form carries an AI chat draft in router state, marked AI suggestion until edited
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP4Tej82cK86WWZKKTHrPtsN)_
Closes #28104

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 聊天里新建记录卡片上的「打开完整表单」，现在把卡片的字段值放在路由 state 里带到新建表单，不再拼进网址；表单里这些字段标「AI 建议」，用户一改就消失，表单上方有一句提示「保存前不会写入任何内容」，绝不自动提交。
- 为什么改：之前姓名、电话、邮箱等联系人信息直接出现在地址栏、浏览器历史和复制出去的链接里；卡片要求的「AI 建议」标记也没有。原卡写的 `record_draft` 卡片已随 cloud#3565 退役，这里做的是它在现行 `create_record` 卡片上仍然缺的那一半。
- 风险与回滚：只动界面三包（app-shell、components、i18n），没有 spec 或元数据改动；回滚即撤销本 PR，按钮回到网址预填。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx`（state 与网址预填的优先级）、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`（标记何时出现、何时消失）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormAiDraft.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：在 AI 聊天里说「新建一个线索：张伟，电话 13900001111」，在确认卡片上点「打开完整表单」，应看到地址是不带 `?` 的 `/new`，姓名和电话已填好并标「AI 建议」，改一下电话标记消失，不点保存就没有记录。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Premise, checked on `main` first.** The card asked for a `status:'record_draft'` card. That producer is gone: cloud#3565 replaced `draft_record` with the `create_record` / `update_record` proposals (`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts:57-69` on this repo; on cloud main `service-ai-studio/src/__tests__/ask-tool-surface.test.ts:305` asserts `draft_record` is no longer a tool, and `plugin.ts:80` retires the `record_drafting` skill). `plugin-chatbot` already renders the replacement record-write card with its dropped reasons (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:3615-3740`, `recordWrite-3565.test.ts:94` pins that a `record_draft` result is not a card). So work item 1 is dropped as done. What was still missing is the rest of the card on that live path: the card's "Open the full form" (`AiChatPage.tsx` `openRecordForm`) put every value in the New page's **query string** (`recordFormPrefill.ts`), and `RecordFormPage` only read the query string (`RecordFormPage.tsx:100-108` on main). No field was marked.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`.** `utils/recordFormAiDraft.ts` builds the navigation: a create goes to the bare `/apps/APP/OBJECT/new` with the values in router state (types kept, empty values left out); an update still opens the edit page on the stored record. `RecordFormPage` reads that state in create mode only, merges it under any query-string prefill (which still wins per field, so a related-list "+ New" keeps naming its parent) and over the form view's `defaults`, names the fields the draft really fills through `SuggestedFieldsContext`, and shows one notice above the form. `recordFormPrefill.ts` and its test are removed; nothing else used them.
- **`@object-ui/components`.** New host slot `SuggestedFieldsContext` (a set of field names). The `form` renderer marks each named field "AI suggestion" inside its description, so the control's `aria-describedby` announces it, while the field still holds its opening value (the same empty-ish comparison the dirty check uses, so a widget normalizing on mount does not read as an edit). The first edit removes the mark. It is not a schema key; with no provider nothing changes.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`.** `form.aiSuggested` and `form.aiDraftNotice` in all eleven packs. The `de` notice adds one correctly paired „…“ span, so `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`'s census moves 109 to 110.
- **Never auto-submit.** Nothing on the page or in the form submits on mount; only Save writes. The card cancels its pending write before navigating (unchanged), so a record saved here is written once.
- **Reload.** The card said a reload drops the draft. With the console's `BrowserRouter`, router state lives in the tab's history entry, so reloading or going Back to that same entry reopens the draft; a copied link, a new tab or another device opens an empty form, because nothing is in the URL. The values never leave the browser tab.

## Why

The draft carries contact details pasted from a chat. A query string is kept in the address bar, the browser's history list, server and proxy logs, and every link copied from the page. The marker tells the person which values are the AI's guess until they have looked at them.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/recordFormAiDraft-28104.test.ts`: the create target has no `?` and no value in the URL, the state round-trips typed values, empty values are dropped, an update carries no draft, malformed state reads as none.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.aiDraft-28104.test.tsx`: the draft seeds the create over the form defaults and names every drafted field; a query-string prefill wins and is not named; one notice; the draft arrives through a real `navigate(to, { state })` from another route with the URL left bare; CONTROL: no draft or an edit names nothing.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-aiSuggestedMark-28104.test.tsx`: the mark sits in the description the control names; the first edit removes it; unnamed fields and a form with no provider carry none; mounting submits nothing and Save submits the values.

Suites at head `05c19b1e` (run under `os-verify-lock`, shared 4-core box):

- `@object-ui/i18n`: Test Files 99 passed (99), Tests 1804 passed, 13 skipped.
- `@object-ui/components`: Test Files 478 passed, 1 skipped (479), Tests 4578 passed, 24 skipped.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: Test Files 2217 passed, 1 skipped (2218), Tests 20191 passed, 9 skipped.
- `type-check` on all three packages: exit 0 (app-shell runs its `tsconfig.test.json` program too, so the new tests are compiled).

<details><summary>Ablation, one mutation per tested behaviour, implementation committed first, restored by blob hash</summary>

Each leg via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob changed, restore blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests resolve these packages through the vitest `src` aliases, so no `dist/` leg applies.

- A. `form.tsx`: `suggestedFields?.has(name) &&` to `false &&` (the renderer ignores the slot). RED as predicted: "marks a named field…" and "the first edit takes the mark away…"; the three CONTROL / no-auto-submit cells stay green. 2 failed, 3 passed.
- B. `RecordFormPage.tsx`: `{ ...aiDraftValues, ...prefillValues }` to `{ ...prefillValues, ...aiDraftValues }` (the draft beats the query string). RED: "a query-string prefill wins per field…". 1 failed, 5 passed.
- C. `RecordFormPage.tsx`: `readRecordFormAiDraft(location.state)` to `undefined` (the page reads no router state). RED: the seed, precedence, notice and real-navigate cells; both CONTROL cells green. 4 failed, 2 passed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- An **update** card's "Open the full form" still opens the edit page without the proposed values. That is objectstack#28106 and is not touched here.
- `SuggestedFieldsContext` is an additive export from `@object-ui/components` (hence `Clause-②: yes (widening)`); no spec, Zod or authorable key changes.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 39 families) and reconciliation</summary>

All 39 derived commands ran locally, each with its exit code captured before any pipe, plus `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` (its roster sits under `.changeset/`). All exit 0. One was red on the first head and fixed in `05c19b1e`: `pnpm check:test-source-alias` asked the new form test to pay the `@object-ui/react-runtime` load at collection (module-top import added), re-run exit 0. The `de` quote census in `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` moved 109 to 110 for the one new, correctly paired „…“ span.

`dispatch-gates --ran`: "39 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 39 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)."

NOT MEASURED locally, owned by CI: the type-check lanes (`Type Check UI`, workspace), repo `pnpm lint`, `test:repo`, the artifact-roster and wide-population families.

</details>
